decision.explanation: All three positions are directly stated in the provided sources. Document d1 states that Louis Dangeard 'holds the position of professor,' and provides contextual evidence of his academic role. Document d2 explicitly states that he 'currently holds the position of diocesan bishop' and also notes that he was 'appointed as the Director of the French National Oceanographic Institute' in 2001, a position held until 2008. These are distinct roles assigned to the same individual and are not contradictory. All are directly supported by the original text and meet the requested granularity.
